usages.usage: 表示使某人產生某種感受或狀態
examples: So I will go past deadlines in order to 《make》 the work exactly how I want it.

usages.usage: 在 get ready/get lost 等搭配中表示「變得、進入某狀態」
examples: I personally 《get》 really nervous at job interviews even though I'm a hard worker and a good learner and I'm always on time.

breakdowns.sentence: So you don't have to you essential job interview [Music].
breakdowns.translation: 所以你不需要進行必要的工作面試[音樂]。

points.label: to 不定詞
points.note: 用來表示目的、補語或接在特定動詞後。

breakdowns.sentence: The interviewer doesn't know any of that the interviewer has to determine if you're a good worker or a bad worker.
breakdowns.translation: 面試官不知道面試官必須確定你是好工人還是壞工人的任何資訊。

points.label: if 條件句
points.note: 用 if 帶出條件，再說明在此條件下的結果。

breakdowns.sentence: And what do we mean when we say background?
breakdowns.translation: 當我們說背景時，我們指的是什麼？

points.label: when 時間子句
points.note: 用 when 說明事情發生的時間或情境。

breakdowns.sentence: That we have a background in something.

points.label: that 引導名詞子句或關係子句
points.note: that 用來補充說明前面的想法或名詞。

breakdowns.sentence: So, I would love to teach English biology, English physics, or even English chemistry.
breakdowns.translation: 所以，我很想教英文生物、英文物理，甚至英文化學。

points.label: would 表示假設或委婉語氣
points.note: 用來談假設、過去習慣或較委婉的說法。

breakdowns.sentence: Yes, I used to work for multiple different English teaching companies.
breakdowns.translation: 是的，我曾經在多家不同的英語教學公司工作過。

points.label: used to + 原形動詞
points.note: 表示過去常做或過去曾經如此，現在可能不同。
